_comment: The model-weights fingerprint matrix. One entry per deeprelay model id.
Roles: subject = the deeprelay model id through api.deeprelay.ai, exactly as a customer calls it (judged);
reference = an independently operated deployment of the same weights (two are needed: their mutual distance
is the same-model band); control = a deliberately different model that must separate from the references,
which is what proves the check can tell models apart.
key_env names an environment variable; never put a key value in this file.
request_extra on a model is merged into EVERY lane's request body for that model, so all lanes condition on
the same thing (for example reasoning_effort: none). A lane's own request_extra is merged on top; a null
value removes a key for that lane. max_tokens on a model applies to all its lanes.
top_logprobs on the subject lane is what to ask the relay for (5). When the relay rejects top_logprobs with
a 400 the harness steps the same probe down to 1, then to no logprobs; the width actually served is in the
report (lanes[].topk and topk_served).
stream: true sends stream: true with stream_options.include_usage and folds the SSE deltas back into the
non-stream response shape (Together serves some models stream-only).
Models the relay cannot serve at temperature 0 are not listed, because the method compares greedy paths:
Kimi K3 is the current example (the relay pins its temperature to 1.0 for that upstream).
The 1017 checkpoint thinks by default on every provider; reasoning_effort: none turns it off on all
three lanes (prompt_tokens 14 on p01 everywhere, content-only logprob streams).
Controls: MiniMax M3 on Fireworks (different family; gating) and the pre-1017 checkpoint on Together
(same family, same template; ADVISORY: at the relay's k=1 it measured lp_delta 0.025-0.030 against
limits of 0.022-0.029 across three runs on 2026-11-03, the edge of what the metric resolves, so it
is reported every run but does not gate the verdict). gpt-oss-120b is NOT
a usable control at k=1: it answers the short prompts with the same near-certainty (lp_delta 0.007)
and its relative signature differs on only 4/12 prompts; see METHOD.md, 'What the test cannot exclude'.
Qwen 3.8 Flash on Together is the second gating control (added 2026-11-06, different host, so one
provider's outage cannot leave the model without a gating control): its relative signature differs on
7/12 prompts, which separates on its own; lp_delta 0.051 vs limit 0.060 at k=1 does not. Together
serves it stream-only.
Together is the only independent deployment that returns logprobs for GLM 5.2 (Fireworks does
not carry it), so the model reads INSUFFICIENT: a verdict needs two logprob references. The
vendor's own API (Z.ai) accepts temperature 0 and reasoning_effort none but returns no logprobs,
so it is a text lane: its greedy answers and prompt_tokens shape are compared with every lane
and reported, without judging. Controls: MiniMax M3 on Fireworks (different family; lp_delta 0.11 vs
limit 0.046) and DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 on Together (added 2026-11-06, different host; relative
signature differs on 3/12 prompts). gpt-oss-120b is not separable at k=1 (lp_delta 0.004, relative
signature 11/12).
Thinking-only on every provider (disabling returns 400), so thinking stays ON everywhere and only the
content segment of each logprob stream is compared. max_tokens 2000 so the reasoning does not exhaust
the budget before any content is emitted. Controls: GLM 5.3 Flash on Fireworks (sibling, thinking on,
content-sliced) and MiniMax M3 on Fireworks (different family, thinking on, content-sliced).
Measured 2026-11-03: the sibling is NOT separable (JS 0.030 vs limit 0.076), so this model reads
inconclusive until the method can tell GLM 5.3 from GLM 5.3 Flash; see METHOD.md.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 on Together (reasoning_effort none on that lane only) is the gating control
on a second host (added 2026-11-06): signature differs on 3/12, JS 0.060 vs limit 0.098 at k=5.
Z.ai (the vendor) returns no logprobs; its lane is text-only and informs without judging.
Thinking-only, same treatment as GLM 5.3. Controls: GLM 5.3 on Fireworks (sibling) and MiniMax M3
on Fireworks (different family, thinking on, content-sliced). Measured 2026-11-03: the sibling is
NOT separable at k=1 (lp_delta 0.016 vs limit 0.077); inconclusive until it is.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 on Together (reasoning_effort none on that lane only) is the gating control
on a second host (added 2026-11-06): signature differs on 3/12, JS 0.045 vs limit 0.066 at k=5.
Z.ai (the vendor) returns no logprobs; its lane is text-only and informs without judging.
Alibaba's own API serves the weights with top_logprobs 5 and needs enable_thinking: false on top of
reasoning_effort: none. Together serves the model stream-only. Fireworks does not serve it.
Measured 2026-11-03: the two references disagree by JS 0.056 (band near the ceiling of what a
different family scores, 0.08-0.09), so the controls sit on the limit: gpt-oss 0.093 vs 0.088
separates, MiniMax 0.083 does not. Both are kept; a run reads inconclusive when either is inside.
DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 on Together is the third control (added 2026-11-06): JS 0.103 vs limit 0.082
at k=5 and signature differs on 7/12, the widest margin of the three, so a day on which gpt-oss and
MiniMax both land inside the limit still has a control that separates on the metric.
